name: ai-native-browser
description: AI-native browser monorepo root: npm workspaces for the Electron desktop app (apps/desktop), the Next.js desktop renderer (apps/renderer), and shared TypeScript packages (packages/contracts, packages/ui), plus a uv-managed Python service under services/browser (not an npm workspace member).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n renderer,browser -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace apps/renderer" "cd services/browser && uv run uvicorn browser_service.app:app --reload --port 8000"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspaces --if-present && cd services/browser && uv run ruff check .
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && cd services/browser && uv run mypy .
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && cd services/browser && uv run pytest -q
scripts.package: npm run build --workspace apps/renderer && npm run build --workspace apps/desktop && npm run package --workspace apps/desktop
